title: MPA-OpenCL: A Differentially Verified Multiple-Precision Arithmetic Library for Heterogeneous Devices
description:
MPA-OpenCL is a portable multiple-precision arithmetic library written in standard OpenCL C. It provides fifteen fixed-width big-integer operations — comparison, addition, subtraction, two multiplication algorithms, exponentiation, division, integer square root, reduction, modular addition and subtraction, two modular multiplication routes, Montgomery multiplication and modular exponentiation — at operand widths from 256 to 2048 bits and machine word sizes of 8, 16 and 32 bits, on any OpenCL 1.2 device.

Its distinguishing feature is verification. Every output word is checked against GMP across the full cross-product of operations, moduli and kernel variants, with directed edge cases and with the test harness itself validated by fault injection; the benchmark verifies each configuration before timing it, so a fast but incorrect kernel cannot be reported as a speedup.

This release includes benchmark reports for 26 GPUs across four vendors and five OpenCL runtimes, covering 10225 timed configurations with no incorrect result attributable to the library.
